title: Trails in miles
prompt: A visitor from abroad wants the North region's trails in miles. Show each trail's name, and its length multiplied by 0.62 as miles.
hints: You'll need a filter and a calculated column.

cases.name: Different trails
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM trails; INSERT INTO trails VALUES (8, 'High Moor', 'East', 12.6, 610), (10, 'Ash Hollow', 'North', 10.0, 200);

solutions: SELECT name, length_km * 0.62 AS miles FROM trails WHERE region = 'North';

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, length_km AS miles FROM trails WHERE region = 'North';
SELECT name, length_km * 0.62 AS miles FROM trails;

title: Budget stationery
prompt: Show the name and price of Stationery products under 3, cheapest first.
hints: This needs a filter and a sort.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL); UPDATE products SET price = 2.5 WHERE id = 9;

solutions: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Stationery' AND price < 3 ORDER BY price;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Stationery' ORDER BY price;
SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Stationery' OR price < 3 ORDER BY price;

title: Without an email
prompt: Show the name of employees with no email recorded, A to Z.
hints: Missing values need a special test.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM employees; DELETE FROM departments; INSERT INTO departments VALUES (5, 'Design'), (6, 'Finance'), (7, 'Ops'); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (11, 'Ivy', 5, NULL, 90000, '2019-02-01', 900, 'ivy@acme.test'), (12, 'Jon', 5, 11, 70000, '2020-06-15', NULL, NULL), (13, 'Kim', 6, 11, 70000, '2023-03-03', 300, 'kim@acme.test'), (14, 'Leo', NULL, 77, 30000, '2024-08-20', NULL, 'leo@acme.test'), (15, 'Mia', 6, 13, 55000, '2022-12-31', 0, 'mia@acme.test');

solutions: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE email IS NULL ORDER BY name;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE email = NULL ORDER BY name;
SELECT name FROM employees WHERE email IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name;

title: Devices in use
prompt: Show each different device used for sessions lasting at least 20 minutes, A to Z.
solutions: SELECT DISTINCT device FROM sessions WHERE minutes >= 20 ORDER BY device;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT device FROM sessions WHERE minutes >= 20 ORDER BY device;
SELECT DISTINCT device FROM sessions WHERE minutes > 20 ORDER BY device;

title: Unfinished work
prompt: Show the student_id and course_id of enrolments with no grade yet.
hints: Think about how a missing grade is stored.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM enrolments; DELETE FROM courses; DELETE FROM students; INSERT INTO students VALUES (6, 'Femi', 9), (7, 'Gia', 9), (8, 'Hao', 10); INSERT INTO courses VALUES (5, 'Chemistry', 'Science'), (6, 'Drama', 'Arts'); INSERT INTO enrolments VALUES (11, 6, 5, 60, '2023-autumn'), (12, 6, 5, 60, '2024-spring'), (13, 7, 5, NULL, '2024-spring'), (14, 7, 6, 95, '2024-spring');

solutions: SELECT student_id, course_id FROM enrolments WHERE grade IS NULL;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT student_id, course_id FROM enrolments WHERE grade = 0;
SELECT student_id, course_id FROM enrolments;

title: Mild spring days
prompt: Show the city, reading_date, and temp_c as temperature for readings from 3 to 7 degrees inclusive.
hints: There's a shorter way than two comparisons.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM readings; INSERT INTO readings VALUES (11, 'Cairo', '2024-07-30', 38, 0.0), (12, 'Cairo', '2024-07-31', 40, NULL), (13, 'Cairo', '2024-08-01', 41, 0.5), (14, 'Quito', '2024-07-31', 15, 3.0), (15, 'Quito', '2024-08-01', 14, 3.0), (16, 'Quito', '2024-08-03', 18, NULL); UPDATE readings SET temp_c = 7 WHERE id = 14; UPDATE readings SET temp_c = 3 WHERE id = 15;

solutions: SELECT city, reading_date, temp_c AS temperature FROM readings WHERE temp_c BETWEEN 3 AND 7;
SELECT city, reading_date, temp_c AS temperature FROM readings WHERE temp_c >= 3 AND temp_c <= 7;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT city, reading_date, temp_c AS temperature FROM readings WHERE temp_c > 3 AND temp_c < 7;
SELECT city, reading_date, temp_c FROM readings WHERE temp_c BETWEEN 3 AND 7;

title: Older non-fiction
prompt: Show the title and year of books published before 2020 that aren't Fiction, newest first.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (10, 'Copper Moon', 'Ada Hill', 'Fantasy', 20.0, 100, 2020), (11, 'North Light', 'Raj Dev', 'Travel', 7.5, 180, 2015), (12, 'Sky Atlas', 'Ada Hill', 'Science', 25.0, 300, 2023);

solutions: SELECT title, year FROM books WHERE year < 2020 AND genre <> 'Fiction' ORDER BY year DESC;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title, year FROM books WHERE year < 2020 ORDER BY year DESC;
SELECT title, year FROM books WHERE year < 2020 AND genre <> 'Fiction' ORDER BY year;

title: Price of a bonus
prompt: Show each employee's name and a pay_total equal to salary plus 5000, for employees earning under 60000.
hints: Calculate in SELECT and filter in WHERE.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM employees; DELETE FROM departments; INSERT INTO departments VALUES (5, 'Design'), (6, 'Finance'), (7, 'Ops'); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (11, 'Ivy', 5, NULL, 90000, '2019-02-01', 900, 'ivy@acme.test'), (12, 'Jon', 5, 11, 70000, '2020-06-15', NULL, NULL), (13, 'Kim', 6, 11, 70000, '2023-03-03', 300, 'kim@acme.test'), (14, 'Leo', NULL, 77, 30000, '2024-08-20', NULL, 'leo@acme.test'), (15, 'Mia', 6, 13, 55000, '2022-12-31', 0, 'mia@acme.test');

solutions: SELECT name, salary + 5000 AS pay_total FROM employees WHERE salary < 60000;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, salary AS pay_total FROM employees WHERE salary < 60000;
SELECT name, salary + 5000 AS pay_total FROM employees;

title: Largest quantity
prompt: Show the order_id, product_id, and quantity of the order item with the largest quantity. If tied, use the lowest order_id.
hints: Sort on two columns and keep one row.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL);

solutions: SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity FROM order_items ORDER BY quantity DESC, order_id LIMIT 1;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity FROM order_items ORDER BY quantity LIMIT 1;
SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity FROM order_items ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 1;

title: Contact cleanup
prompt: Show the full_name and city of contacts in London or Geneva, or with no city recorded.
hints: A list won't match a missing value.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM contacts; INSERT INTO contacts VALUES (11, 'mary jackson', 'mary-j@club.test', '555-0111', 'Hampton', 'SILVER GOLD1'), (12, 'BOB Kahn', 'bob@CLUB.test', '555-0112', NULL, 'gold1'), (13, 'Rosa Park', 'rosa@club-test', NULL, 'Tuskegee', 'NEW'), (14, 'Ken Thompson', 'ken.t@club.test', '5550114', 'Murray', 'GOLD3');

solutions: SELECT full_name, city FROM contacts WHERE city IN ('London', 'Geneva') OR city IS NULL;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT full_name, city FROM contacts WHERE city IN ('London', 'Geneva');
SELECT full_name, city FROM contacts WHERE city IS NULL;
